thesis: Chaos Orb made physical dexterity part of tournament Magic, turning card placement and a one-foot flip into an answer capable of destroying almost any permanent it touched.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: {1}, {T}: If this artifact is on the battlefield, flip it onto the battlefield from a height of at least one foot. If this artifact turns over completely at least once during the flip, destroy all nontoken permanents it touches. Then destroy this artifact.
